cues: And grafting: a shoot of the variety you want, the scion, is joined onto a hardy rooted stock.
The apple orchards of Mustang and Jumla are grafted.
text: Growers copy plants on purpose. Cuttings of sugarcane and rose. Layering in jasmine and litchi. And grafting: a shoot of the variety you want, the scion, is joined onto a hardy rooted stock. The apple orchards of Mustang and Jumla are grafted.
